name: Earth Arcade
description: Four warriors who gathered to catch the moon rabbit who fled to Earth! A new concept hybrid multiverse action adventure variety that unfolds across time and space begins!

videos.title: To Thailand
videos.overview: Lee Eun Ji, Mimi, Lee Young Ji and An Yu Jin meet for the first time to start their journey. Before they leave for Thailand, they play a game to decide what they’re going to wear to the airport. Once they arrive in Bangkok, they play a game to decide who will get to eat the food cooked by a retired royal chef.

videos.title: Playing Games to Win Thai Beer and Food
videos.overview: For the first night in Thailand, Thai beer and various snacks have been prepared. However, to eat those the members must win a game of rock-scissors-paper. And later on, the members compete in a retro music quiz to get a chance to eat Thailand street food.

videos.title: Action Strawberry Game
videos.overview: While the members are getting a Thai Massage everyone disappears while leaving behind a note leaving the members to find their own way back. The members play a game of Action Strawberry Game to get some free time, but due to the difficulty the members have a hard time playing.

videos.title: Craving Korean Food
videos.overview: For the members who are craving Korean food, the staff prepares a three-course Korean meal, but they must play a game and win in order to eat it. The members arrive at Ko Samui island which is full of romance, but they have to play another game to win drinks.

videos.title: New and Improved Perfect Pitch Game
videos.overview: The Perfect Pitch game has been upgraded and the moment they fail, they have to face a new and even worse penalty. They also play a game to win Thai food, but to the producer’s surprise, they are very good at it so the producer makes a deal and asks for a rematch.

videos.title: Ice Cream Man
videos.overview: The members participate in a wake-up mission. All the members stay up all night, but only two can win. The members are diving in a pool where an ice cream man appears. If they get the quiz right, they get free ice cream and if not, they get a penalty.

videos.title: Random Play Dance
videos.overview: Random play dance is back and the member’s favorite Korean dish is on the line. They show great teamwork and skills to win the dish. They also split into teams to buy ingredients and cook, but the catch is the ingredients team cannot talk to the cooking team.

videos.title: Khao Sok National Park (1)
videos.overview: In this episode, the members pair up and try to guess which K-pop song a Thai staff is singing. The members leave Ko Saumi and head to Khao Sok National Park. Nana's Store on Board opens one last time before the members head into the jungle.

videos.title: Khao Sok National Park (2)
videos.overview: The members head into the Jungle. They participate in a social media challenge by taking a photo in the tree house. Afterward, they head to a Thai restaurants the staff picked out and play Action Strawberry Game. The journey is coming to an end and for the member who are still super excited, they decided to play a game.

videos.title: To Gangwon-do
videos.overview: After the members return, in the episode they go head to Gangwon-do. The members participate in a snack quiz to earn money so they can go shopping before leaving for vacation. As soon as the arrive in Gangwon-do, they head to a noodle restaurant, but since Producer Na is late, the staff goes on a strike.

videos.title: Gelato Quiz
videos.overview: Next on the schedule is the dessert. They play the snack quiz to win a chance to have gelato made with natural regional products. Afterward, the move on to the last dance party of the season to win a barbeque dinner.

videos.title: The Final Episode
videos.overview: The final episode reveals the first morning mission in Thailand which was never seen before. Also the members visit a café and find out it is the last episode and Producer Na grants them a wish as a goodbye present.

videos.title: The New Season Begins
videos.overview: The four women come together once more to catch the runaway rabbit, Torong. Lee Eun Ji, Mimi, Lee Young Ji, and An Yu Jin join forces for a second season. The Earth Warriors travel to locations around the globe with their new multiverse selves. Hailing from the Drama Kingdom of Korea, the four warriors leave for Finland, where snow, food, and games await.

videos.title: Games Out Of Control
videos.overview: The four warriors face their first crisis, as they must compete with each other to get their meals and presents. It starts with a simple game, but things quickly spin out of control.

videos.title: Sauna And Zombies
videos.overview: The four warriors spend a great night together, they rise the next day for a sauna. Competing for food and snacks, they start their second day with a bang. There is another game waiting for them back in their quarters.

videos.title: Playing While Jet Lagged
videos.overview: Eun Ji, Mimi, Young Ji, and Yu Jin continue their journey through Helsinki, Finland. They must play games for Finnish snacks and food while fighting off their hunger as well as their drowsiness from being severely jet-lagged. Meanwhile, Young Ji and Producer Na Yeong Seok go see the Baltic Sea as the other members go shopping.

videos.title: Going To The North Pole
videos.overview: The arcade players hop on a train and head to Rovaniemi, a village in the Arctic Circle. After a 12-hour train ride, they enjoy some unexpected food. On the last day of their trip to Finland, they must take down Torong who has learned to clone himself. Which of the six Torongs is the real one?

videos.title: Trying To Leave For Bali
videos.overview: After the arcade players catch the real Torong, they get to go on a trip to Bali as a reward from the Jade Emperor. In preparation for the trip, they dress up as K-pop stars of the past. However, Torong tries to sabotage their departure and steals their suitcases. Will they catch Torong and retrieve their suitcases on time to get to Bali?

videos.title: Earth Arcade In Bali
videos.overview: The arcade players finally arrive in Bali! Everyone is excited by the new scenery, and they especially look forward to tasting the food. However, they have to play games to earn money, time, and food, as can be expected from Director Na. How will the arcade players fare in a new land? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: The Bali Trip Continues
videos.overview: The arcade players’ fun in Bali gets fired up as they play hilarious games with delicious food at stake. However, when an added penalty of a morning cardio workout on an empty stomach is on the line, the players willingly give up sleep to try to win. Which players will get to enjoy a yummy meal while the others work out?

videos.title: Working Out In Bali
videos.overview: After Mimi and Young Ji get a taste of the spinning class, they recommend it to the other members as well. After all the arcade players get a taste of exercising on an empty stomach, they play games to fill their stomachs. However, some of the games feel like a workout as well. An intense game of hide-and-seek ensues.

videos.title: Music Janghak Quiz
videos.overview: The arcade players get together to play an exciting game of Music Janghak Quiz. They listen to songs of various genres and have to guess whose song it is or where it is from. This time, the prize isn’t food, as it usually is. Each represents a meaningful place, which arcade player will get to take home the biggest prize?

videos.title: The Second to Last Day in Bali
videos.overview: As the last day of the trip is just around the corner, the arcade players get to enjoy some one-day tours of Bali’s hottest places. Later on, they play their signature game of Random Dance Play to win souvenirs provided by the Jade Emperor. As the last morning dawns, the arcade players find themselves in a surprise predicament.

videos.title: The Last Day of Earth Arcade 2
videos.overview: It is the last day of Earth Arcade 2, and the arcade players enjoy Bali until the very end of their trip. However, during an unplanned interview on their last morning, Torong makes a return. He locks the players in their rooms and dares them to get out in time to catch their flight home. Will the arcade players make it out on time?

videos.title: The Gathering of Secret Agents
videos.overview: The members receive a mission to find Torong, who ran off with Jade Emperor’s corporate card, in Abu Dhabi. Through the first game, guess the bread, they decide whether to dress as a spy or as their past selves. On the day of their departure, Eun Ji realizes that she forgot to bring their most essential item, making the rest of them panic. Will they able to overcome this crisis?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: In this episode, for the first game, there's a fancy royal set that the royals of Abu Dhabi enjoy with a total of 18 Middle Eastern brunch menus. The members will play simple games, and if they fail to win, they lose one dish at a time. Through a fierce competition for survival, will they be able to try the food in front of them?

videos.title: The Morning Mission for Digital Detox
videos.overview: They finally get to play the new game called SBA Game, which stands for Strawberry, Banana, and Apple. Why do the members look broken while playing the game when they are good dancers? They play the new game for local snacks and even a laptop! Then the Morning Mission for a digital detox begins. They have to say "Good morning" exactly at 8am without their phones. With their electronic devices gone, they turn into TVs. How will the members go through the night without their phones?

videos.title: Going out to Downtown Abu Dhabi to Find Torong
videos.overview: The members go downtown in disguise to chase after Torong. They perfectly hide their identities with local makeup and clothes. They finally get to taste the gold coffee Torong tried at a luxurious eight-star hotel. Then they play Answer in a Row, where only one person who gives the correct answer can enjoy boiling seafood. With the crazy speed and numerous wrong answers, the evening game gets more thrilling.

videos.title: Heading to Lisbon, Portugal in Pursuit of Torong and Cheol Yong
videos.overview: Cheol Yong, whom the members trusted, betrays them and runs away to Lisbon, Portugal, the mecca of backpacking. For perfect infiltration, the secret agents try to disguise themselves as backpackers. For many different types of backpacks, they play Reverse Perfect Pitch where perfect pronunciation and key are important. Will the members win the backpack they want and head to Portugal? Before the flight to Lisbon, Young Ji challenges the production crew to a battle of cooking ramyeon. If Young Ji wins, she can finally put an end to her digital detox and get her phone back. Will she be able to win the match and dive into the world of dopamine again?

videos.title: The E-cade Member's Romantic First Day in Lisbon
videos.overview: In Portugal, the country of Ronaldo, the members play the 2-on-2 Charades to get a soccer uniform. There's no time limit, and the game continues until they answer all the keywords correctly. It never ends no matter how frustrating it is. After the unprecedented chaos, which team will win the game and get to buy a soccer uniform? Then the new game Three-Syllable Karaoke begins, which requires their perfect teamwork. They have to win the game in order to enjoy Koreans' beloved Portuguese dishes, Arroz de Marisco and gambas a guilho! They must succeed in the game with a perfect sense of rhythm and pitch. Will they be able to pull off the new game and enjoy a lovely dinner?

videos.title: The E-cade Members' Self-Guided Tour Around Lisbon
videos.overview: The E-cade members start their first self-guided tour in Lisbon for the photography contest where they should submit photos with the theme of three Ps, purity, passion, and Portugal. Eun Ji finally forgets about her babysitting duty and enjoys her free time. Yu Jin only thinks about the members even when she's alone. Mimi and Young Ji are attacked by pigeons when they are off guard. Who will win the photography contest and become the ending fairy of the episode? Then they start a romantic beer-bike trip near the Tagus River. Only the ones who answer the questions about general knowledge can stop pedaling and enjoy beer. At a famous restaurant beloved by Ronaldo and many celebrities, the E-cade members try the Guess Who quiz for Portuguese specialties. While Mimi shows a remarkable performance, Yu Jin is having a mental breakdown?

videos.title: The E-cade Members Chasing After Torong and  Cheol Yong
videos.overview: The production crew, who is exhausted by the E-caders’ high energy, rises in revolt and plays the 4-on-4 mini-curling game against the members. If the E-caders lose, they will go on the Mouth Detox! A match for the production crew’s eardrums. Who will be the winner? In the middle of the Thieves' Market, NANA Souvenir Shop is open. They must give the correct answers to buy the souvenirs they want! While they play the games with a lot of complaints, Torong and Cheol Yong’s traces are found! They must go to the Riddle Master to catch Torong. A large-scale chase across Lisbon continues. At night, the members finally meet Korean food after six days of their trip. They must succeed in the Complete the Word game to enjoy the food of their hometown. Will they be able to pull off the mission and have Korean food for dinner?

videos.title: The E-cade Members’ 1 Million View Challenge Mission
videos.overview: A new mission customized for the E-cade members begins. They must get 1 million views in 10 minutes. If they succeed, they can enjoy Digital Flex. But if they fail, they will get a penalty of Mouth Detox, where they have to remain silent during lunch. The behind-the-scenes stories of the “Give Me My Money” challenge are finally revealed. After lunch, they move to Albufeira, a famous vacation spot in southern Portugal. They enjoy the peaceful moment with the blue sea and dazzling sunlight. With the romance fully charged, they start Earth Arcade’s signature game, Random Play Dance, which they have been waiting for two years. They throw a crazy dance party with franchise delivery food on the line. Things are heating up with their breathtaking performances. What is the music that surprises everyone?

videos.title: The New Games at a Winery
videos.overview: The members carry out individual morning missions in secret. In order not to have their missions caught, they pretend to have different missions. The penalty for those who fail the missions is running 5km. Later, they visit a winery in Portugal, where they play various new games to win wine and gimbap.

videos.title: The Wrap-up of Season Three
videos.overview: The E-caders are ready to wrap up Earth Arcade 3 with a big gonggi battle with everything on the line. While the members’ wish will be granted if they win, the staff prepares an even bigger penalty for their loss that shocks the team. After coming back to Korea, the E-caders hold a bizarre rooftop party to celebrate the end of the season and play a game of curling to determine who will get to keep what from their journey in Portugal.
